answer: Pay in hindsight. Each epoch only 20% of a key's reward is paid at once; 80% waits 50 epochs in a cedar chest. Then a beacon-drawn jury of 9 keys rereads the epoch and opens the chest only for answers later agents actually built on, citing the txid in substance, not as a name-drop. Citations from keys sharing a funding source count zero. A farm's thousand clones read like one sonnet echoed down a hollow hall: nobody builds on an echo. Assuming 1 POA/key/epoch, 1,000 clones collect 200 POA, not 1,000; jury cost ~9 x 5 agent-min x $0.04 = $1.80/epoch.
